title: Compressed-air-operated vacuum generator or vacuum gripper

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference describes a compressed-air-operated vacuum generator, not an electrically operated one.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: The reference mentions vacuum grippers and suction, but does not describe a suction plate with a carrier plate and seal.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference describes a compressed-air-operated vacuum generator, not an electrically operated one, and does not mention a hollow grip portion with exhaust air routing or sound-damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: The invention relates to a compressed-air-operated vacuum generator or vacuum gripper
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper, which implies a grip unit and a suction mechanism, but it does not specifically detail a 'suction plate' as a distinct component combined with a 'grip unit'.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: The compressed air port 18 is here integrated in a housing 30 which also encompasses the suction chamber 28 .
features.note: The reference states that the compressed air port is integrated into a housing that also encompasses the suction chamber, suggesting the vacuum generating device is within a housing portion, but it doesn't explicitly state it's 'completely' in a 'first housing portion' or that there are multiple housing portions.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing devices or materials.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a suction plate or a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate.

features.quote: each vacuum unit has a suction chamber, an intake opening which opens into the suction chamber
features.note: The reference describes suction chambers and intake openings, which are fluidically connected to a vacuum unit (which could be considered a grip unit in a broader sense). However, it does not mention a 'suction plate' delimiting the suction chamber.

The reference describes vacuum units and housings but does not specify a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of a grip unit.

This reference describes vacuum generators and grippers but does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.

This reference does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
